expect.sql: SELECT SUM(total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'

title: What is our revenue per country?
prompt: What is our revenue per country? One row per country: the country, then its revenue, highest revenue first.

expect.sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(o.total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY 2 DESC

title: How many orders have we sold?
prompt: How many orders have we sold?

expect.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'

title: What is our average order value?
prompt: What is our average order value?

expect.sql: SELECT AVG(total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'

title: What is our net revenue, after refunds?
prompt: What is our net revenue, after refunds?

expect.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_cents) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid')/100.0 - (SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM refunds)/100.0

title: Which customer has spent the most?
prompt: Which customer has spent the most? Return the customer's name and the amount.

expect.sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

title: How much revenue came from customers in Germany (country DE)?
prompt: How much revenue came from customers in Germany (country DE)?

expect.sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND c.country = 'DE'

title: How many of our customers have bought something?
prompt: How many of our customers have bought something?

expect.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'

title: What is the amount of our largest single sale?
prompt: What is the amount of our largest single sale?

expect.sql: SELECT MAX(total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'

title: What was our revenue in March 2026?
prompt: What was our revenue in March 2026?

expect.sql: SELECT SUM(total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND placed_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
